description: List the games: with a workspace key, every game in the workspace (its id, name, client token and the services reporting to it); with a key for one game, its services, versions, environments and when they were last seen.

game.description: The game, by name or id, when signed in to a workspace (glitchless_list_games lists them); later calls keep it. With a key for one game (gl_sk_…), a call that names another game is refused: sign in to the workspace to reach every game.

name: glitchless_list_games
title: List games
